messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed ~15% increase in streaming early-closes on prod since the canary rolled out at 08:42.
sam: seen it too, mostly SSE connections from EU region
maria: deploy-bot flagged the canary but console shows no spike in error rate, only in stream-close count :thinking_face:
ops-bot: [ALERT] stream.close_count >= 100 (5m) region=eu proxy=front-12
lee: quick dump of a failing connection trace:
```
seq=4321 session=abcd-1234 route=/v1/stream token=token-xyz
client: START -> proxy
proxy: FIN_WAIT from edge, then 200 then FIN
```
olivia: looks like edge is sending a half-close then immediately re-opening? could be the proxy keepalive mismatch
maria: console sampling shows client-side pings at ~10/s for some clients — these are in a client cohort where we enabled aggressive reconnect backoff in the canary
sam: that cohort also hit a quota rollup -> window_rate_limit=600/s for the tenant
lee: hmm if client pings are being rate-limited at the proxy, it might tear the SSE stream and the runtime emits an early close metric. But why does the errors console not show 5xxs?
maria: because the proxy swallows the 429 and does a soft-close, no 5xx bubble up. telemetry tag mismatch: stream.close_reason is "soft_close" (internal) not propagated to console alerting
olivia: can we reproduce locally? set a client to ping at the rate and watch proxy logs
sam: repro easy on staging — I'll run a loadscript
maria: UI problem: the console charts sample session counts with a 1m rollup; early-close spike happened in a 10s window so sampling missed it. Suggestion: add 10s sampling mode for stream metrics in the console
lee: For quick mitigation we can tweak the proxy's keepalive window to 45s for canary and re-run, or rollback the client-side backoff change
maria: prefer increasing console visibility and adding tag propagation so alerts trigger on soft_close too
olivia: +1 on tags. Also add trace_id to stream metrics: that would help tie client->proxy->runtime
sam: action items:
- add trace_id propagation to proxy->runtime metrics (olivia)
- add 10s sampling option for stream charts in console (maria)
- temporary increase proxy keepalive in canary zone (lee)
- repro on staging and attach traces (sam)

lee: I'll open a quick PR to bump keepalive and set a canary flag
maria: filing a bug: https://issue.tracker/RED-2345 stream early-close sampling + tag propagation
ops-bot: Incident created RED-2345 assigned to ops
sam: repro started, sending 2k clients with 8-12 pings/sec, will post logs
maria: thanks — let's meet 20m to decide rollback vs roll forward :calendar:
sam: noted, will post an ETA
olivia: small nits: console UX should default to 1m but show a "burst mode" toggle; will mock later
maria: :thumbsup:
